messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Region az1c - resolver handshake failures causing gRPC resets for inference ephemeral pool (g5-ephemeral). Spike started ~04:07 UTC, rule=resolver-handshake-stampede.

devon-oncall: seeing lots of UNAVAILABLE / ECONNRESET from inference proxies in az1c. Errors clustered to a handful of resolver-proxy instances. Switching to mitigation. :rotating_light:

jamal-sre: confirmed TCP SYN retries to resolver IPs; CPU & conn-counts on proxy nodes are saturated. Plan: drain ephemeral hosts in az1c, steer new traffic away, and reduce DNS TTL. Starting ops now.

nora-eng: preparing routing policy change to prefer eu-west-1 for inference-edge for next 15m. Will set weight=90% and leave 10% for validation.

kelsey-support: customers? any visible user impact or top customers affected? cc: @ops-shift

devon-oncall: initial impact: ~8-10% request error rate for text-gen and embeddings in az1c; p95 latency increased ~600ms. No full region outage. No public status page incident yet, holding until mitigation shows effect.

jamal-sre: running drain commands on candidate nodes now:
```bash
kubectl cordon node/g5-eph-az1c-02
kubectl drain node/g5-eph-az1c-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
# apply routing shift
rdctl route set-weight --name inference-edge --from az1c --to eu-west-1 --weight 90
```

devon-oncall: +1 to drain. Note: KV-cache miss spike expected after drain — will watch model quality impact.

ops-shift: opened incident channel, assigned followups. Notifying CS to prep targeted outreach if error budget crosses 15% or customers report degraded SLA. @kelsey-support can you triage top-10 impacted customers and severity? :clipboard:

kelsey-support: pulling customer logs now, will DM priority list in 5m. Sending short internal note now.

jamal-sre: submitted cloud support case (case#372891) for resolver appliance behaviour. Also lowering DNS TTL for edge resolver cache to 10s to accelerate regen.

incident-bot: Pager escalation: devon-oncall -> devon-oncall acknowledged at 04:12 UTC.

devon-oncall: handing primary to jamal-sre for mitigation work, and to nora-eng to monitor the routing shift and cross-AZ capacity for next 30m. Jamal primary, Nora secondary.

nora-eng: scaling eu-west-1 fallback pool by +20% now to absorb shifted traffic. Expect warmup/scale within ~90s; watch tail-latency.

jamal-sre: mitigation steps summary: 1) drain az1c ephemeral nodes 2) route-weight shift to eu-west-1 (90%) 3) lower DNS TTL to 10s for faster client cache recovery 4) increase fallback capacity 5) prepare model-variant fallback (quantized) if errors continue.

devon-oncall: update @04:18 UTC: error rate down to ~2.4%, p95 latency back to ~+120ms. KV-cache miss elevated but acceptable. Monitoring for 30m. If stable, close pager and create RCA ticket.

kelsey-support: preliminary targeted customer notice sent to affected accounts explaining regional resolver issue and that we’ve rerouted traffic; will send full incident update in 1 hour.

jamal-sre: collecting artifacts for RCA: tcpdumps from proxy nodes, DNS query logs (stub->resolver), kvcache hit rates, host telemetry. Tagging incident: az1c-resolver-handshake-stampede.

devon-oncall: handing back to on-call rotation at 04:35 UTC. If regression, repage. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated and monitoring. Last mitigation action at 04:35 UTC.
